headline: Clear costs before families commit.
introduction: Every roster invitation will include the estimated season cost, anticipated tournament schedule, payment deadlines, and a clear explanation of what is included. RFGF plans to charge one published season fee for the core club program and tournament schedule.
family_costs: Families may also be responsible for transportation, lodging, meals, and spectator admission during tournament weekends. Few, if any, events are expected to require overnight travel.
assistance: Limited financial assistance and payment-plan options are intended when resources allow. Requests will be handled privately and evaluated based on demonstrated need, available funding, and program expenses.
refunds: Refund eligibility will depend on which expenses the club can recover. Tournament registrations and customized uniforms generally become nonrefundable once the club commits those funds. Documented season-ending injuries will be reviewed individually.
